messages:
mia chen: Heads up — release CI failed on the typegen/publish step. regen-diff only shows changelog timestamp changes, no API surface diffs. Anyone else hit this?

ci-bot: [automated] Pipeline 'publish' failed: typegen-regendiff check. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/2765432109/artifacts (regendiff.zip)

jonathan: Saw that locally earlier. Usually clock skew or a generator formatting change. Did you run the same typegen version as CI?

samir: Quick repro on my laptop: `./scripts/regenerate.sh` -> diff only touched the changelog header timestamp. No semantics changed.

mia chen: Hmm — we pin typegen in the publish workflow. Which version did CI pick up?

alex d: CI used typegen v1.4.2 per the workflow image. My dev box had v1.5.0 (newer) and it switches changelog timestamps to ISO format. That would explain the tiny diffs.

samir: Repro snippet I ran: 
```
GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="2026-03-23T12:01:05Z" GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="2026-03-23T12:01:05Z" npm run typegen:regen
git --no-pager diff -- CHANGELOG.md
```
Only this shows up: 
```diff
diff --git a/CHANGELOG.md b/CHANGELOG.md
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-## v1.2.3 - 2026-03-23T12:01:05Z
+## v1.2.3 - 2026-03-23T12:02:17Z
```

mia chen: OK that matches. Two options: pin the generator in the workflow (fast) or add logic to ignore/normalize timestamps in regen-diff (longer but more robust). Thoughts?

jonathan: For a hotfix -> pin in workflow. For medium-term -> canonicalizer that strips datestamps before diff, plus a test to ensure deterministic output. We keep hitting noisy regendiffs that block publishing.

leo: :+1: Also consider a small unit test in typegen that asserts idempotency given fixed env dates. Saves a lot of churn.

alex d: I'll review a PR if you open one to pin the version. Also filing an issue to track the canonicalizer work.

mia chen: Thanks — opening PR now to pin to v1.4.2 in .github/workflows/publish.yml and adding a short comment. Creating the canonicalize issue too. Will link both here when ready.

ci-bot: Created issue #452: "Canonicalize changelog timestamps to avoid noise in regen diffs" (assigned to mia chen)

mia chen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/852 — pins typegen v1.4.2 and adds a unit test pointer. @alex d please review when you have a sec.

alex d: Reviewing now, looks good at a glance. After merge we should rerun the publish job to confirm green.

samir: After this, we should also add a small check in the regendiff job: ignore lines that match `/^## v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ - \d{4}-/` so timestamp-only changes don't fail the gate.

jonathan: Agree. I'll draft the canonicalizer design in the issue so we can schedule it in the next sprint.

mia chen: Great teamwork — thanks everyone :sparkles:
